x.author: LeonBennetts
x.body:
Translation: He was sick of paying Whoop a subscription to get metrics from my fitness tracker.l and being locked in to their app.

So he created my own spin-off of “noop” (presumably an open source package built to connect with Whoop bands) which he calls “zhoop”

He has an open source AI agent for tracking fitness stuff and so now it gets data from his Whoop band via my iPhone using an open source messaging protocol.

So now he has a completely open source health tracking system and the vendor
